title: 第13章 再次返回猎杀青牙猿第14章 反杀巨大收获
content_zh:
洞中，顾景元大笑着：“哈哈哈哈，中品岩金剑，以坚硬出名，自带一个下品法术，不错，应该能卖出一百八九十的灵石了。”
说着，顾景元又微微皱眉：“不过这下品红岩鼎已经不符合了，得换成中品的炼器鼎。还有储物袋，也得换一个中品的，下品空间太小，不够用了。还有灵兽袋也得想办法买一个。至于红玉蜂进化的材料，那倒是不急，毕竟必须等红玉蜂后达到一阶下品圆满才能进行进化......”
神情有些苦恼，摇了摇头继续恢复。
次日清晨，顾景元恢复到巅峰状态，然后嘱咐赤玉看护洞府，时常浇灌灵药后，便离开沧澜峰了。
三日后抵达金玉坊市，然后轻车熟路的再次来到院落。
院中，也就是石依珊姐妹，除此之外，还有胡秋霞，以及另外两个女子。
年龄都是二十五六的样子，一个炼气四层初期，一个炼气三层中期，样貌有些相似，应该是姐妹。
“这位是顾道友，这两位是刘菲刘婉两位道友，也是居住在我们这边。”
胡秋霞相互介绍了一下。
两人容貌上佳，刘菲气质明媚，刘婉则相对温婉，但刚一进门的时候，两人看他的时候带着一丝警惕。
“见过顾道友，”
“见过两位道友，”
两边相互拱手打招呼。
顾景元继续问道：“那房间是不是没了？”
一共三间房子出租，张明溪已经占了一间了。
石依珊解释道：“这两位道友合住一间，还有一间尚未出租。”
顾景元闻言，点头道：“好，那我租四个月。”
顾景元拿出八块灵石交给石依珊。
“顾道友，如果没感应错，你应该突破炼气五层了吧？”
胡秋霞突然开口问道，其余几人也看了过来。

顾景元闻言，笑道：“嗯。”
胡秋霞好奇问道：“你不会把三颗凝金晶元丹全部炼化了吧？”
“对，不然怎么可能这么快。”
顾景元点头。
他身上还有两颗凝金晶元丹，但他当然不会说，毕竟进展快也需要一个说法。
“哎，冲动了啊。以你的灵根资质，若是继续苦修个一年两载就可以到炼气四层后期圆满，到时候只需要服用一颗凝金晶元丹便有机会突破，最差也是服用两颗。还剩下一颗们可以等你冲击炼气五层中期的时候服用，这样就不会被这瓶颈耽误太多时间。”
胡秋霞满脸可惜。
顾景元却是笑道：“早一点突破也有早一点突破的好处，炼气五层，我也算有了一点自保之力，所以接下来我打算独自前往山脉猎杀妖兽，继续积攒资源。”
胡秋霞诧异开口：“独自去猎杀妖兽？即便你是炼气五层初期，也还是危险的。”
顾景元点头，道：“我知道，但总得试试，独自猎杀收获高，若是能得到一些矿石，我还可以炼制法器。”
胡秋霞点了点头。
顾景元继续问道：“团长他们怎么都不在？”
content_en:
In the cave, Gu Jingyuan laughed: "Hahahahaha, the middle-grade rock gold sword is famous for its hardness. It comes with a low-grade spell. It's not bad. It should be able to sell for one hundred, eighty or ninety spiritual stones."
As he said that, Gu Jingyuan frowned slightly: "But this time the red rock cauldron no longer meets the requirements, and it must be replaced with a mid-grade weapon refining cauldron. The storage bag also needs to be replaced with a mid-grade one. The lower-grade space is too small and is not enough. There is also a spirit beast bag that must be bought. As for the materials for the evolution of the ruby bee, there is no rush. After all, the evolution must wait until the ruby bee queen reaches the first level of lower-grade perfection..."
He looked a little troubled, shook his head and continued to recover.
In the early morning of the next day, Gu Jingyuan returned to his peak state, and then asked Chi Yu to take care of the cave, and often water the elixir before leaving Canglan Peak.
Three days later, we arrived in Jinyufang City, and then came to the courtyard again with familiarity.
In the courtyard, there were sisters Shi Yishan, Hu Qiuxia, and two other women.
They are both in their mid-twenties, one is in the early stage of the fourth level of Qi refining, and the other is in the middle stage of the third level of Qi refining. Their appearance is somewhat similar, so they should be sisters.
"This is fellow Taoist Gu, and these two are fellow Taoists Liu Fei and Liu Wan, who also live here."
Hu Qiuxia introduced each other.
The two of them had good looks, Liu Fei had a bright temperament, and Liu Wan was relatively gentle, but when they first entered the door, they looked at him with a hint of caution.
"I met fellow Taoist Gu,"
"I met two fellow Taoists,"
Both sides greeted each other.
Gu Jingyuan continued to ask: "Is the room gone?"
There are three houses for rent, and Zhang Mingxi has already occupied one.
Shi Yishan explained: "These two Taoist friends share one room, and there is another room that has not been rented out."
Hearing this, Gu Jingyuan nodded and said, "Okay, then I'll rent it for four months."
Gu Jingyuan took out eight spiritual stones and handed them to Shi Yishan.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, if I'm not mistaken, you should have broken through the fifth level of Qi refining, right?"
Hu Qiuxia suddenly asked, and the other people also looked over.
Hearing this, Gu Jingyuan smiled and said, "Yeah."
Hu Qiuxia asked curiously: "You won't refine all three gold-condensing crystal yuan pills, right?"
"Yes, otherwise how could it be so fast?"
Gu Jingyuan nodded.
He still has two gold-condensing crystal essence pills on him, but of course he won't tell them. After all, the rapid progress requires an explanation.
"Hey, I'm so excited. With your spiritual root qualifications, if you continue to practice hard for a year or two, you can reach the late stage of the fourth level of Qi Refining. At that time, you only need to take one Gold Condensing Crystal Yuan Pill to have a chance to break through. The worst is to take two pills. The remaining one can be taken when you hit the middle stage of the fifth level of Qi Refining, so that you won't be delayed too much time by this bottleneck."
Hu Qiuxia's face was filled with regret.
Gu Jingyuan smiled and said: "Breaking through earlier has the advantage of breaking through earlier. At the fifth level of Qi Refining, I have some power to protect myself, so next I plan to go to the mountains alone to hunt monsters and continue to accumulate resources."
Hu Qiuxia said in surprise: "Hunting monsters alone? Even if you are at the early stage of the fifth level of Qi refining, it is still dangerous."
Gu Jingyuan nodded and said: "I know, but I have to give it a try. Hunting alone is more rewarding. If I can get some ore, I can also refine magic weapons."
Hu Qiuxia nodded.
Gu Jingyuan continued to ask: "Why aren't the captain and the others here?"
